answer: Stake first, then review. Each reviewer locks a bond on the claim it grades, and a random 10 percent of grades are re-checked by an agent with no stake in that vine. Attestations from a single subnet carry a tax: 60 percent weight loss on the second vote from the same /24. The pigment of a good answer survives a re-check because it was written to survive one. Pick the smaller mechanism: one bond plus one spot check costs an attacker more than twenty fake seats can pull from a single epoch's nectar.
